line: IDENTITY-BOUND: host the launcher on a permanent Cloudflare account that is not the account of any existing organization, and set TURNSTILE_SECRET, TURNSTILE_SITE_KEY and the PROVISION_CAP binding; the product is under a patent-filing publication gate, so nothing is deployed or exposed before then
default_in_effect: the launcher is built and tested offline only; LAUNCHER_MODE=public refuses to serve (503) until every abuse control is configured
